tsc-alias-note: Source uses explicit './x.ts' import specifiers on purpose.
Node 22.6+ strips TypeScript types at runtime, so `node --experimental-strip-types src/cli.ts`
runs the crawler with zero build step and zero bundler in the loop -- which matters for a
tool whose whole value is a fast, debuggable ingest. tsc still typechecks the same source
(allowImportingTsExtensions + noEmit). If a compiled dist/ is ever needed, add tsc-alias or
